CREATE TABLE `censos` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `tipo` TEXT NOT NULL, `fecha` INTEGER NOT NULL, `estado` TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `lotes` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `nombre` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE TABLE `lineas` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `loteId` TEXT NOT NULL, `numero` TEXT NOT NULL, `cantidadArboles` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE `registro_frutos` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `censoId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `loteId` TEXT NOT NULL, `lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `arbolCodigo` TEXT NOT NULL, `posicion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sexo` TEXT, `frutos` INTEGER, `estado` TEXT NOT NULL, `muerto` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `capturado` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `verificadoEn` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE `registro_produccion` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `censoId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `loteId` TEXT NOT NULL, `lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `vivos` INTEGER, `muertos` INTEGER, `resiembras` INTEGER, `observacion` TEXT, `estado` TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `registro_floracion` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `censoId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `loteId` TEXT NOT NULL, `siembra` TEXT, `lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `arbolCodigo` TEXT NOT NULL, `posicion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sexo` TEXT, `inflorescencias` INTEGER, `botones` INTEGER, `estado` TEXT NOT NULL, `muerto` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `capturado` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `verificadoEn` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE `lineas_omitidas` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `censoId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `responsable` TEXT)

CREATE TABLE `plantas` (`lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `codigo` TEXT NOT NULL, `posicion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `siembra` TEXT, `sexo` TEXT, `muerto` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `alerta` TEXT, `filasOrigen` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`lineaId`, `codigo`))
CREATE TABLE `avance_floracion` (`censoId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `posicion` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`censoId`, `lineaId`))
CREATE TABLE `catalogo_importado` (`version` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`version`))

CREATE TABLE `borradores_ficha` (`tipo` TEXT NOT NULL, `censoId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lineaId` TEXT NOT NULL, `posicion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sexo` TEXT, `muerto` INTEGER NOT NULL, `a` TEXT NOT NULL, `b` TEXT NOT NULL, `c` TEXT NOT NULL, `observacion` TEXT NOT NULL, `actualizadoEn` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`tipo`, `censoId`, `lineaId`, `posicion`))
